name: ticker
definition: S&P 500 listing, uppercase, dots not dashes

name: company_name
definition: Index constituent name

name: cik
definition: SEC central index key, zero padded

name: gics_sector
definition: GICS sector, 11 values

name: gics_sub_industry
definition: GICS sub-industry

name: nace_section
definition: NACE section, the PAB high-impact-sector test. Taken from the sibling listing, or from the sector mode, on the four listings portfolio.parquet does not carry

name: is_primary_listing
definition: False on GOOG, FOX and NWS; filter this before summing anything

name: share_class_siblings
definition: The other listing of the same registrant, where one exists

name: hq_country_iso
definition: Headquarters country or US state as the index publishes it

name: date_added
definition: Date the listing entered the index

name: scope1_measured_us_t
definition: EPA GHGRP Scope 1, fossil only, equity apportioned, net of perimeter changes

name: scope1_measured_us_year
definition: Reporting year of scope1_measured_us_t

name: scope1_measured_allgas_t
definition: The same roll-up including biogenic CO2, for reconciliation only, never a headline

name: scope1_biogenic_t
definition: Biogenic CO2, gas_id 8, reported separately as the GHG Protocol requires

name: scope1_ar6_t
definition: scope1_measured_us_t with CH4 and N2O restated from AR4 to AR6 GWPs, a band not a fix

name: scope1_lookahead_excluded_t
definition: Tonnes removed because the facility was not inside the perimeter that year

name: scope1_facility_count
definition: Distinct GHGRP facilities behind scope1_measured_us_t

name: ghgrp_matched_zero_fossil
definition: Matched to GHGRP facilities and measured zero fossil tonnes in every year: checked and found zero, not missing

name: scope1_current_signal_t
definition: Latest CAMD stack-measured CO2. A currency check only: its boundary is Acid Rain and CSAPR combustion units, not the company, so it never sets a level

name: scope1_current_signal_year
definition: Year of scope1_current_signal_t

name: scope1_selfreported_t
definition: Company-declared global Scope 1, WBA climate profile first, PDF report second

name: scope1_selfreported_year
definition: Fiscal year of scope1_selfreported_t

name: scope1_selfreported_source
definition: wba or report_pdf

name: scope1_modelled_t
definition: Climate TRACE equity share, an asset inventory with no corporate boundary. Equity, not gross: gross double counts joint ventures

name: scope1_modelled_year
definition: Release year of scope1_modelled_t

name: scope1_t
definition: The decided Scope 1: self-report where it clears the EPA-measured floor, else GHGRP fossil equity, else Climate TRACE, else null

name: scope1_year
definition: Fiscal or reporting year of scope1_t

name: scope1_basis
definition: self_reported | ghgrp_fossil | ghgrp_fossil_floor | climatetrace_equity

name: scope1_dq
definition: PCAF data quality of scope1_t: 1 verified mandatory, 2 reported, 4 modelled

name: scope1_below_measured_floor
definition: The company reported a global Scope 1 below what EPA measured on its US sites alone, so the mandatory figure won

name: scope2_market_t
definition: Scope 2. WBA does not label market against location basis, so scope2_basis says which table spoke rather than which accounting basis

name: scope2_basis
definition: wba (basis unlabelled) or report_pdf (market)

name: scope2_dq
definition: PCAF data quality of scope2_market_t

name: scope2_location_t
definition: Location-based Scope 2 where a report stated it separately

name: scope2_year
definition: Fiscal year of scope2_market_t

name: scope3_total_t
definition: Total Scope 3 as declared. Not summable across the index: one company's Scope 3 is another's Scope 1

name: scope3_basis
definition: wba or report_pdf

name: scope3_dq
definition: PCAF data quality of scope3_total_t

name: scope3_year
definition: Fiscal year of scope3_total_t

name: scope12_t
definition: WBA combined Scope 1+2, the only voluntary series with a multi-year history. For a trend only, never into a Scope-1-only column

name: scope12_year
definition: Fiscal year of scope12_t

name: grid_factor_hq_g_per_kwh
definition: eGRID subregion emission factor for the HQ region

name: power_intensity_g_per_kwh
definition: Generation-weighted intensity of the company's own plants, the Article 12(1)(g) test

name: power_gen_mwh
definition: Net generation behind power_intensity_g_per_kwh

name: delivered_pct_yr
definition: OBSERVED annual change in measured tonnage, OLS on the longest clean window. Negative is falling. This is the model's abatement input, never the promised rate

name: delivered_basis
definition: Which measured series the fit ran on; ghgrp on all 134

name: delivered_dq
definition: PCAF data quality of delivered_pct_yr: 2, an OLS on mandatory tonnage

name: delivered_se_pct_yr
definition: Bootstrap standard error of delivered_pct_yr

name: delivered_r2
definition: R squared of the log-linear fit

name: delivered_n_years
definition: Years in the fitted window

name: delivered_year_start
definition: First year of the fitted window

name: delivered_year_end
definition: Last year of the fitted window

name: delivered_camd_pct_yr
definition: The same fit on CAMD stack data, which runs to 2025 where GHGRP stops at 2023

name: promised_pct_yr
definition: Implied annual reduction from the company's own target, negative is falling. Ours first, WBA for the 17 it covers and we do not

name: promised_basis
definition: sbti_s12_absolute | nzt_interim | netzero_inferred | sbti_combined | wba

name: promised_dq
definition: PCAF data quality of promised_pct_yr

name: promised_target_year
definition: Target year the promised rate was implied from

name: promised_baseline_year
definition: Baseline year of the target

name: gap_pct_yr
definition: delivered minus promised. Positive means the company is cutting more slowly than it said

name: sbti_near_term_status
definition: SBTi near-term target status

name: sbti_near_term_classification
definition: SBTi temperature classification of the near-term target

name: sbti_net_zero_status
definition: SBTi net-zero target status

name: sbti_net_zero_year
definition: Stated net-zero year

name: revenue_musd
definition: SEC XBRL revenue, latest fiscal year carrying the field. Their sec_revenue is rejected: it takes the contract-revenue tag, which is a crumb for a bank or a REIT

name: revenue_basis
definition: sec_xbrl on every row that has one

name: revenue_dq
definition: PCAF data quality of revenue_musd

name: revenue_fy
definition: Fiscal year of revenue_musd

name: revenue_period_end
definition: Fiscal year end. 119 of 502 FY2023 rows end outside December

name: ebit_musd
definition: SEC XBRL operating income, latest fiscal year carrying the field

name: ebit_basis
definition: sec_xbrl on every row that has one

name: ebit_dq
definition: PCAF data quality of ebit_musd

name: ebit_fy
definition: Fiscal year of ebit_musd

name: capex_musd
definition: SEC XBRL capital expenditure, latest fiscal year carrying the field

name: capex_fy
definition: Fiscal year of capex_musd

name: da_musd
definition: Depreciation and amortisation. The only D&A anywhere in the project, taken from the teammate's extraction rather than our own

name: da_basis
definition: sec_secondhand: an SEC figure we did not extract ourselves

name: da_fy
definition: Calendar year of da_musd

name: ebitda_musd
definition: Our SEC operating income at the D&A's own year plus that D&A, else Yahoo's trailing twelve months. Their sec_ebitda is rejected: it inherits their EBIT

name: ebitda_basis
definition: sec_ebit_plus_secondhand_da | yahoo_ttm

name: ebitda_dq
definition: PCAF data quality of ebitda_musd

name: ebitda_fy
definition: Fiscal year of ebitda_musd; null where the basis is a trailing twelve months

name: total_debt_musd
definition: SEC XBRL total debt, Yahoo where SEC has none

name: total_debt_basis
definition: sec_xbrl | yahoo

name: total_debt_dq
definition: PCAF data quality of total_debt_musd

name: total_debt_fy
definition: Fiscal year of total_debt_musd where the basis is sec_xbrl

name: total_cash_musd
definition: Cash and equivalents. New to the project; our XBRL pull has none

name: market_cap_musd
definition: SEC cover-page shares times the 2026-09-11 price, with four up-C names taken from Yahoo because the cover page counts one share class

name: market_cap_basis
definition: sec_shares_x_price | yahoo_override_upc | yahoo

name: market_cap_dq
definition: PCAF data quality of market_cap_musd

name: market_cap_shares_stale
definition: Share count is from a cover page filed before 2026, while the price is 2026-09-11. This is the 10 to 25 per cent band against Yahoo, a staleness to flag not a bug

name: evic_musd
definition: Enterprise value including cash, market cap plus total debt, as PAB Article 5 defines it. Deliberately gross of cash: it is the financed-emissions denominator

name: evic_debt_observed
definition: False where evic_musd is market cap alone because no debt figure exists

name: ev_musd
definition: Enterprise value net of cash, for the valuation leg. We have none of our own

name: ev_ebitda_x
definition: EV/EBITDA multiple, winsorised to the sector 5th and 95th percentile then clamped to [4, 40], with the sector median where Yahoo publishes no positive EBITDA

name: ev_ebitda_basis
definition: yahoo | yahoo_winsorised | sector_median

name: ev_ebitda_dq
definition: PCAF data quality of ev_ebitda_x

name: ev_ebitda_raw_x
definition: The unguarded vendor multiple, kept so the guard is visible: three are negative and eleven exceed 60x

name: fcf_musd
definition: Free cash flow. New to the project, not used by the model chain

name: beta_x
definition: Equity beta. Needed only if the reweight is risk adjusted

name: revenue_ttm_musd_check
definition: Yahoo trailing-twelve-month revenue. A cross-check only: TTM and fiscal year are different periods and must not be mixed

name: index_weight_pct
definition: Market cap share of the 500 primary listings. Secondary listings carry 0 so the column sums to 100

name: price_usd2010_per_t
definition: NGFS Net Zero 2050, Downscaling[GCAM 6.0 NGFS], USA, 2030, exactly as published. Not averaged across models: GCAM says 98.6 and REMIND 283.7 for the same scenario

name: price_sector_usd_per_t
definition: The stored default carbon penalty, price_usd2010_per_t deflated by 1.44. The UI overwrites this per sector; NGFS itself publishes no sector differentiation

name: coverage_scope1_pct
definition: Share of Scope 1 the penalty touches. Settable

name: coverage_scope2_pct
definition: Share of Scope 2 the penalty touches. Settable

name: coverage_scope3_pct
definition: Share of Scope 3 the penalty touches. Zero by default: pricing Scope 3 across a 500-company index charges the same tonne several times

name: passthrough_pct
definition: Share of the carbon cost pushed to customers. NO EMPIRICAL SOURCE EXISTS IN THIS REPO. A sector assumption with a default, settable, and labelled modelled everywhere

name: carbon_cost_musd
definition: Priced tonnes times the penalty, before abatement. Null where no scope is known; a scope that is null inside a company that has another contributes nothing

name: abatement_factor
definition: (1 + delivered_pct_yr/100) ^ (2030 - scope1_year). 1.0 where no observed rate exists, which is the conservative reading: no credit for an unmeasured cut

name: carbon_cost_abated_musd
definition: carbon_cost_musd after the company's OBSERVED reduction rate is run to 2030

name: d_ebit_musd
definition: Abated carbon cost that lands on earnings, after the passthrough assumption

name: d_ebit_pct_of_ebit
definition: Earnings at risk. Null where operating income is zero or negative, never a ratio against a negative denominator

name: d_ev_musd
definition: Change in enterprise value, the earnings hit capitalised at the company's own multiple

name: d_ev_pct_of_ev
definition: Value at risk. This is the reweighting input

name: model_dq
definition: Worst PCAF grade among the inputs that fed d_ev_musd. Never better than 5 because passthrough is an assumption

name: excl_12g
definition: The Article 12(1)(g) test: a power generator above 100 gCO2e/kWh

name: excluded
definition: Any EU 2020/1818 Article 12 exclusion fires

name: excl_articles
definition: Which articles fire, semicolon separated

name: excl_basis
definition: Which screen decided the exclusion: sec_segment (measured segment revenue tested against the article threshold), gics_proxy, nbim_exclusion, or power_intensity_12g where only the 100 gCO2e/kWh test fires. Null where nothing fires

name: excl_dq
definition: PCAF data quality of the exclusion decision: 1 where measured segment revenue was tested against the article's own threshold, 4 or 5 for a sector proxy

name: high_impact_nace
definition: NACE high-impact sector under the PAB rules, derived from nace_section on the four listings portfolio.parquet does not carry

name: penalty_usd_environment
definition: Violation Tracker environmental penalties, 2000-2026

name: case_count_environment
definition: Environmental enforcement cases behind that total

name: penalty_usd_total
definition: All Violation Tracker penalties, every offence group

name: conduct_measured_zero
definition: Searched and found no environmental penalty. A measured zero, not a missing value

name: vendor_percentile
definition: Consensus percentile across six free ESG datasets. VENDOR: a benchmark for our score, never an input to it

name: vendor_n_sources
definition: How many vendor datasets carry the company

name: our_percentile
definition: Our score as a percentile, built from mandatory and voluntary data only

name: rank_median
definition: Median rank over the uncertainty draws, 1 is best

name: rank_p05
definition: 5th percentile of the rank distribution

name: rank_p95
definition: 95th percentile of the rank distribution. rank_p95 minus rank_p05 is the honest width of the answer

name: coverage_tier
definition: measured (mandatory tonnage), reported (voluntary only) or unmeasurable

name: score_mirrored_from
definition: The primary listing whose score this secondary listing copies

name: provenance_class
definition: Provenance of scope1_t: mandatory where EPA measured it, voluntary where the company declared it, modelled where Climate TRACE inferred it, null where nobody knows. Never vendor, by construction and by assertion

name: financial_provenance_class
definition: Worst class among the four financial facts we extracted ourselves: revenue, EBIT, debt and market cap. EBITDA and the multiple are excluded because they are vendor by design and carry their own _basis

name: generated_at
definition: When this row was built
